$comment: Journal of retired component-tier names — the `--dx-*` custom properties the theme publishes. A published name is the one thing a user can rely on without rebuilding the SCSS, so removing or renaming one is a public change, and this file is where that change is recorded. Add the entry in the SAME change that retires the name — which change that was is a question for `git log -- tools/naming/public-renames.json`, so the journal does not repeat it; tests/public-renames.test.ts then enforces that the name never appears in a built fluent-next bundle again, which is what forbids a quiet compatibility alias in _public-links.scss.

fields.name: The retired name, exactly as it shipped.
fields.replacement: The name that takes over the role, or null when the role itself disappeared.
fields.release: The release the removal ships in.
fields.note: One sentence for the release notes: who this reaches and what they see. Written from the user's side, not ours.
